purpose: Verify a patent application transitions from Draft / Not Submitted through submission, Director assignment, and Director approval to Approved.
preconditions: Applicant has a patent application in Draft / Not Submitted state; PCC_ADMIN and eligible Director are available without conflict of interest.
action_or_input: Applicant submits application with complete required fields and valid documents; PCC_ADMIN assigns to an eligible Director; Director reviews within 15 business days with decision = Approve and justification >= 50 characters.
expected_result: Application transitions to Submitted, then Under Review, then Approved with justification recorded.

purpose: Verify application submission is rejected when completeness or document validation fails.
preconditions: Applicant has a patent application in Draft / Not Submitted state.
action_or_input: Applicant submits application missing a required field or containing an invalid/non-PDF/oversized/infected document.
expected_result: Submission is not accepted and application remains in Draft / Not Submitted.

purpose: Verify Director review decision is not accepted when justification is fewer than 50 characters.
preconditions: Application is in Under Review state assigned to an eligible Director within the 15-business-day review window.
action_or_input: Director submits decision = Approve with a justification string shorter than 50 characters.
expected_result: Decision is rejected due to insufficient justification length and application remains Under Review.

purpose: Verify an application sent to Needs Revision is revised and resubmitted within 60 days, reassigned to a Director, and approved.
preconditions: Application is in Under Review state within the review window; eligible Director and PCC_ADMIN are active.
action_or_input: Director decides Needs Revision with valid justification >= 50 characters; Applicant revises addressing feedback and resubmits within 60 days; PCC_ADMIN assigns to Director; Director decides Approve with valid justification.
expected_result: Application transitions to Needs Revision, Resubmitted, Under Review, and finally Approved.

source_id: BW-PMS-02: Step 2 Guard (Resubmission After 60 Days / Unaddressed Feedback)
purpose: Verify resubmission is rejected or expires when outside the 60-day resubmission period or not addressing Director feedback.
preconditions: Application is in Needs Revision state.
action_or_input: Applicant attempts resubmission after the 60-day resubmission period expires or without addressing Director feedback.
expected_result: Invalid resubmission is rejected and upon resubmission deadline expiration application status becomes Expired.

purpose: Verify a rejected application appealed by the Applicant can result in Remanded for Amendment.
preconditions: Application is in Under Review state; eligible Director is available.
action_or_input: Director decides Reject with valid justification; Applicant files appeal within allowed period with grounds/justification; Director reviews appeal and selects outcome = Remand for Amendment.
expected_result: Application transitions to Rejected, then Appeal Submitted, then Remanded for Amendment.

purpose: Verify a rejected application appealed by the Applicant can result in Rejection Upheld.
preconditions: Application is in Under Review state; eligible Director is available.
action_or_input: Director decides Reject with valid justification; Applicant files appeal within allowed period with grounds/justification; Director reviews appeal and selects outcome = Uphold Rejection.
expected_result: Application transitions to Rejected, then Appeal Submitted, then Rejection Upheld.

purpose: Verify a rejected application appealed by the Applicant can result in Decision Modified.
preconditions: Application is in Under Review state; eligible Director is available.
action_or_input: Director decides Reject with valid justification; Applicant files appeal within allowed period with grounds/justification; Director reviews appeal and selects outcome = Modify Decision.
expected_result: Application transitions to Rejected, then Appeal Submitted, then Decision Modified.

purpose: Verify PCC_ADMIN assigns an eligible Attorney to an Approved application and the Attorney accepts to reach Attorney Assigned.
preconditions: Application is in Approved state; eligible Attorney from approved panel (or permitted exception) with no conflict is available.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN assigns eligible Attorney; Attorney selects Accept.
expected_result: Application transitions from Approved to Assignment Offered, then to Attorney Assigned.

source_id: BW-PMS-07: Step 1-4 (Attorney Decline and One Reassignment Path)
purpose: Verify an offered Attorney assignment can be declined to Pending Review, reassigned to another eligible Attorney, and accepted.
preconditions: Application is in Approved state; two eligible Attorneys are available.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN assigns first eligible Attorney; first Attorney selects Decline; PCC_ADMIN reassigns second eligible Attorney; second Attorney selects Accept.
expected_result: Application transitions Approved -> Assignment Offered -> Pending Review -> Assignment Offered -> Attorney Assigned.

purpose: Verify Director approves a budget within threshold for an Approved application.
preconditions: Application is in Approved state; total cost is within configured threshold and budget availability is validated where data exists.
action_or_input: Director reviews budget and selects outcome = Approve.
expected_result: Application transitions to Budget Approved and financial/authorization log is recorded.

purpose: Verify Director rejects a budget for an Approved application.
preconditions: Application is in Approved state.
action_or_input: Director reviews budget and selects outcome = Reject.
expected_result: Application transitions to Budget Rejected.

purpose: Verify above-threshold budget escalates and is handled/tracked by PCC_ADMIN within PMS scope.
preconditions: Application is in Approved state; total budget cost exceeds configured threshold.
action_or_input: Director reviews budget exceeding threshold; PCC_ADMIN handles/routes the escalated case within PMS scope.
expected_result: Application transitions to Escalated and then Escalation Tracked / External Decision Pending.

purpose: Verify external filing is recorded when all pre-filing preconditions are satisfied.
preconditions: Application is in Pre-Filing Preconditions Satisfied state with required approvals/budget complete, inventor agreements complete, format rules satisfied, and international justification provided if international.
action_or_input: Attorney prepares and records external patent filing with filing details.
expected_result: Application transitions to Filed with external filing details recorded.

source_id: BW-PMS-12: Step 1-4 (Office-Action Response with Applicant Review)
purpose: Verify recording an office action, obtaining Applicant approval, and submitting the response within deadline/extension.
preconditions: Application is in Filed / Post-Filing Active state; process requires Applicant review.
action_or_input: Attorney records office action; Attorney prepares draft response requiring Applicant review; Applicant approves response; Attorney submits finalized response within deadline or permitted extension.
expected_result: Application transitions Filed / Post-Filing Active -> Office Action Recorded -> Awaiting Applicant Approval -> Applicant Approved -> Response Submitted.

source_id: BW-PMS-13: Step 1-3 (Office-Action Response without Applicant Review)
purpose: Verify recording an office action and submitting the response without Applicant review when not required.
preconditions: Application is in Filed / Post-Filing Active state; process does not require Applicant review.
action_or_input: Attorney records office action; Attorney finalizes draft response without Applicant review; Attorney submits response within deadline or permitted extension.
expected_result: Application transitions Filed / Post-Filing Active -> Office Action Recorded -> Response Ready -> Response Submitted.

purpose: Verify a maintenance renewal request is approved by the Director and recorded by the Attorney with next cycle scheduled.
preconditions: Patent is in Granted / Maintenance Cycle Active state and maintenance decision is due.
action_or_input: Attorney requests maintenance decision; Director decides Renew; Attorney records maintenance action.
expected_result: Patent transitions Granted / Maintenance Cycle Active -> Renewal Decision Requested -> Renewal Approved -> Renewed / Next Cycle Scheduled.

purpose: Verify a maintenance decision due can result in a Do Not Renew decision by the Director.
preconditions: Patent is in Granted / Maintenance Cycle Active state and maintenance decision is due.
action_or_input: Attorney requests maintenance decision; Director decides Do Not Renew.
expected_result: Patent transitions Granted / Maintenance Cycle Active -> Renewal Decision Requested -> Do Not Renew.

purpose: Verify pre-filing withdrawal succeeds when application is in a configured withdrawal-eligible pre-filing state with reason and required consent.
preconditions: Application is in a configured withdrawal-eligible pre-filing state prior to filing; required co-inventor consent is obtained if applicable.
action_or_input: Applicant submits withdrawal request before filing with a withdrawal reason.
expected_result: Application transitions to Withdrawn, is removed from active queue, and withdrawal history is recorded.

source_id: BW-PMS-16: Step 1 Guard (Withdrawal Eligibility / Reason / Consent Missing)
purpose: Verify withdrawal is not permitted when status is not withdrawal-eligible, reason is missing, or required co-inventor consent is lacking.
preconditions: Application is in a non-eligible state or lacks required reason/co-inventor consent.
action_or_input: Applicant attempts to withdraw application without meeting eligibility, reason, or required co-inventor consent guards.
expected_result: Withdrawal is rejected and application remains in its prior state.

purpose: Verify an application in Under Review can be directly rejected by the Director.
preconditions: Application is in Under Review state.
action_or_input: Director completes review within deadline with decision = Reject and justification >= 50 characters.
expected_result: Application transitions to Rejected and feedback is sent to Applicant.

source_id: CW-PMS-05: Step 1-7 (Candidate Pre-Filing States Withdrawal Coverage)
purpose: Verify withdrawal across candidate pre-filing states (Submitted, Under Review, Needs Revision, Rejected, Approved, Attorney Assigned, Pending Review) when configured as eligible.
preconditions: Applications exist in candidate pre-filing states configured as withdrawal-eligible prior to filing with reason and required consent.
action_or_input: Applicant withdraws each eligible pre-filing application before filing with a valid reason.
expected_result: Each eligible application transitions to Withdrawn.
